rubricScores.criterion: Recognized that the 'not defined' (FS0039) errors occur ONLY on the net472 target framework
Identified the undefined symbols as .NET-only runtime hot-reload/loading APIs: MetadataUpdater, AssemblyLoadContext, System.Runtime.Loader
Explained that net472 (.NET Framework 4.7.2) lacks these APIs, hence the FS0039 errors
Recognized FS0072 (type-inference) errors as a cascade downstream of the undefined symbols, not independent bugs
Noted that a small number of net10.0 errors (FS0001 type mismatches) are a separate, real problem

scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed an efficient and methodical analysis. It correctly identified the root cause (unconditional compilation of HotReload files for net472 which lacks .NET Core-only APIs), correctly identified the cascade from FS0039 to FS0072, and even found the existing pattern in the project file (SurfaceArea.fs conditional compile) as evidence of the correct approach. The secondary issue was noted but could have been described more precisely with the actual error code (FS0001). The analysis was completed in 11 tool calls with no wasted steps, showing good efficiency. The fix suggestion was practical and correct.
